payloads.name: Blackwire
payloads.description: Stream extracted PS5 games and supported PFS/PFSC or contiguous exFAT images from up to two SMB shares on one PC. Automatic Media shortcut setup and embedded reader installer. Normal build with private tracing/timing/verbose Send logs disabled. Requires a compatible jailbreak, Kstuff and ShadowMountPlus. Web interface on port 5918.
payloads.author: XXD3V3L0P3RXX
